instruction: Navigate to the MileagePlus frequent flyer program information page.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from United Airlines homepage to their MileagePlus frequent flyer program page. Uses existing is_expected_url_pattern_match metric to verify the URL pattern. No custom functions needed.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_active_url_from_accessTree() properly extracts the active tab URL from accessibility tree
Metric logic is correct: is_expected_url_pattern_match() correctly searches for URL pattern in the result
Data flow is semantically sound: getter extracts URL -> metric receives URL (string or dict) -> metric matches pattern
Expected URL pattern 'united.com/en/us/fly/mileageplus' is semantically correct for United's MileagePlus program page
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies that navigation to MileagePlus page was successful
No postconfig needed: checking active tab URL doesn't require dialog state or additional setup
Will work correctly at runtime: accessibility tree extraction is reliable for getting active URL
